highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.157.0 improves GPU geometry, clipping, and displacement-filter correctness without changing the public managed API.
highlights_body: These native fixes retain the Skia m157 engine line.

bullets.detail: Corrects axis mapping for corner radii and stroke widths, removes the redundant quarter-turn swap, and clamps radii to half the transformed bounds to prevent overlapping corners.
Updates Ganesh flush-token tracking so atlas work from one flush is not incorrectly considered pending in a later flush.

Includes unrecorded clips in pass-capacity checks without double-counting recorded clips. A draw whose full clip stack cannot fit in a fresh pass is warned about and skipped; a pass exactly at capacity remains valid.
Computes displacement scale and offsets at float precision to match filter bounds and avoid rounding differences in sampling positions. Color-channel samples and selectors remain half precision.

Propagates failed fence waits into the native synchronous submission result, preserving timeout retries and asynchronous behavior. GRContext.Submit remains void and discards that result; no managed failure-reporting API is added.
